title: Missed Installments, Default and Cure — Property Charge Advance Repayment
content:
Under Property Charge Advance Repayment, an installment counts as missed when it is not fully paid by the end of the plan's grace period in calendar days after its due day, and each installment is recorded as missed at most once. An arrangement defaults on the day the count of missed installments reaches the plan's figure of missed installments that defaults it, and a default notice is sent within the product's default-notice period in calendar days. A default is cured only when every missed installment is paid no later than the plan's cure period in calendar days after the default date. Those days are counted as calendar days starting the day after the default date, and payment on the last counted day still cures; an uncured default is referred. Arrangements without installments, the Lump-Sum Repayment and the At-Risk Extension, never default through missed installments.

## Counting missed installments

The count is the number of installments recorded as missed on the arrangement from the date the agreement was signed, inclusive, through the day of handling, inclusive — that is, over the life of the arrangement. An installment, identified by its installment number, is recorded as missed only once; whether it is already on record is read from the arrangement's records before it is recorded.

| Plan | Missed installments that default it | Cure period after the default date |
|---|---|---|
| Repayment Plan - 12 Months | 2 | 30 calendar days |
| Repayment Plan - 24 Months | 2 | 30 calendar days |
| Repayment Plan - 36 Months | 2 | 30 calendar days |
| Repayment Plan - 60 Months | 3 | 30 calendar days |
| Lump-Sum Repayment | Does not default through missed installments | Not applicable |
| At-Risk Extension | Does not default through missed installments | Not applicable |

## Cure boundary (hypothetical dates)

- Default date 4 August: day 1 of the count is 5 August and day 30, the last counted day, is 3 September.
- Every missed installment paid by 3 September: the default is cured and the arrangement resumes.
- The last missed installment paid on 4 September: the default is not cured, and an uncured default is referred.

## Points of judgement

- A missed installment that is later paid stays in the count, which runs over the life of the arrangement.
- Curing requires every missed installment, not only the most recent one.
- The default date that starts the cure count is read from the arrangement record.

The dates are illustrative only.
